title: 1900 Carlist Sublevation
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1900 Carlist Sublevation", at revision 1370278958, opens: "The Carlist uprising of October 1900 was an attempted armed insurrection that originated in Badalona, a city on the border with Barcelona, and which spread to other towns in Spain, although the attempted rebellion quickly failed." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16163640, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item carries no description in English or Portuguese. Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
